description.narrative: AC4ALL aims to redirect anticorruption efforts to reduce inequality through fiscal and budgetary reforms and practices in Mexico, reducing inequality for those most left behind in Mexico, particularly, women, youth and ethnic minorities through fair and transparent redistributive policies and new forms of civic engagement.Recognising that illicit financial flows and transnational elements undermine efforts to promote sustainable development and to reduce inequality, the project includes a series of initiatives at regional and global levels, led by the TI Secretariat, that will complement and support the work carried out domestically by TI Mexico. Value of the contract is EUR 3,666,666.
